title: parse.rs: unnecessary clone of child_ids in multipart arm
description: build_part (line 135-136) does 'let ids: Vec<u32> = child_ids.clone(); ids.iter()...' The clone exists only because the author did not try iterating the reference directly. child_ids is a &Vec<u32> from the match arm, so child_ids.iter() works without cloning. Suggested rewrite: remove the 'let ids' binding and replace with 'child_ids.iter().enumerate().map(|(n, &child_idx)| { ... })'.
